chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who applies oil and massages himself with oil and flour, he (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.الدَّقِيق: fine flour or semolina used for cleansing
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it (permissible)
key_terms.يَتَدَلَّكُ: to rub or massage the body

ai.seo_question: Does using oil and flour for exfoliation invalidate ritual purity during a bath?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the reliable chain of Ibn Abi Umayr and the precise observer Hisham ibn al-Hakam, establishes the permissibility of using oil and fine flour for physical cleansing during ghusl. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that external substances used for hygiene do not create a barrier (hijz) to water reaching the skin, provided they are not applied in a thick, impermeable layer. This ruling underscores the practical ease Islam affords believers in maintaining ritual purity during daily hygiene routines.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Abu Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the man who waxes and massages with the oil and the flour. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Ishaq ibn ‘Abd al-’Aziz who has said the following:

“Once abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about rubbing with flour after lime. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’ I then said, ‘They think it is misuse of flour.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Use of things for the benefit of body is not a misuse. I sometimes ask for bleached flour mixed with oil and rub. Misuse is when one’s belongings are destroyed and the body is harmed.’”
